objectives: Memendekkan beberapa relative clause tanpa mengubah hubungan makna dasar antara noun dan verb.
Mengenali struktur yang tepat dari beberapa contoh.

blocks.text: Memendekkan beberapa relative clause tanpa mengubah hubungan makna dasar antara noun dan verb.
Active relative clause → -ing phrase; passive relative clause → V3 phrase. Pengurangan tidak selalu cocok jika kehilangan informasi waktu/identitas.
Students who live nearby → Students living nearby
Data that were collected yesterday → Data collected yesterday
The report written by Mei is available.

blocks.incorrect: The books borrowing yesterday are here.
blocks.correct: The books borrowed yesterday are here.
blocks.explanation: Buku menerima aksi borrowed, bukan melakukan borrowing.

blocks.text: Saat menjawab soal, perhatikan subjek dan struktur klausa terlebih dahulu, baru tentukan bentuk yang sesuai. Jangan hanya memilih jawaban karena kedengarannya familier.

practice.prompt: The samples ___ in the lab were sealed.

translationId.prompt: Sampel yang ___ di laboratorium telah disegel.

practice.explanation: People who are waiting outside → people waiting outside.
